title: tasks/discover/airtable_cross_check.json (v3.0)
description: Aggregate result of import_airtable.py's cross-check: for every institution with url_status=confirmed in schools.csv, whether the confirmed chtr_url matches the existing Airtable schools-registry base's 'chtr_index_url' field (the field that mirrors the actual CHTR page URL -- not 'Transparency Report', which only reflects compliance status and is left blank for institutions with a real, non-compliant CHTR page). Read by 02-archive's write_data_check to populate data_check.json's airtable_cross_check field, and by status.py to report discover.airtable_mismatches.
